header: "Not Valid for the Object's Storage Class" snapshot error
content:
OpenSearch Service snapshots do not support the Amazon Glacier storage class. You might
encounter this error when you attempt to list snapshots if your S3 bucket includes a lifecycle rule
that transitions objects to the Amazon Glacier storage class.
If you need to restore a snapshot from the bucket, restore the objects from Amazon Glacier, copy
the objects to a new bucket, and register the new bucket as a snapshot repository.
